'''Malinna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a gear vendor during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, she operated a stall in the [[Alien Enclave Market]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Voss-Ka]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].

==Behind the scenes==
Malinna first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game she serves as a Republic and Imperial specialty vendor on the planet Voss.
